commands: $all=New-Object System.Collections.Generic.HashSet[string]([StringComparer]::OrdinalIgnoreCase); foreach($slug in $slugs){$p=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ('https://danbooru.donmai.us/wiki_pages/' + [uri]::EscapeDataString($slug) + '.json') -Headers $headers -TimeoutSec 30; foreach($m in [regex]::Matches($p.body,'\[\[([^\]|#]+)')){$name=$m.Groups[1].Value.Trim(); if($name -and $name -notmatch '^(?:Tag group:|wiki:)'){[void]$all.Add($name)}}}

$py=@'
import sqlite3,sys,re,json,base64
db,names_path=sys.argv[1:3]
with open(names_path,encoding='utf-8-sig') as f: names=[x.strip() for x in f if x.strip()]
BLOCK=[r'(^|\b)loli($|\b)',r'(^|\b)shota($|\b)',r'\bminor\b',r'\bunderage\b',r'\bchild\b',r'minigirl',r'miniboy',r'rape',r'bestiality',r'mating \(animal\)',r'incest',r'guro',r'forced',r'slave',r'strangl',r'torture']
def blocked(s):
    x=s.lower(); return any(re.search(p,x) for p in BLOCK)
def norm(s): return re.sub(r'\s+',' ',s.replace('_',' ').replace('\\(','(').replace('\\)',')').strip().lower())
def disp(s): return s.replace('\\(','(').replace('\\)',')').replace('_',' ')
con=sqlite3.connect(db)
rows=con.execute('select raw,category,count from tags').fetchall(); idx={norm(r):(r,c,n) for r,c,n in rows}
out=[]
for name in names:
    if blocked(name): continue
    row=idx.get(norm(name))
    if row:
        raw,cat,count=row
        if cat!=0: continue
        out.append({'raw':raw,'display':disp(raw),'count':count})
    else:
        out.append({'raw':name,'display':name,'count':0})
seen=set(); uniq=[]
for x in sorted(out,key=lambda x:(-x['count'],x['display'].lower())):
    k=norm(x['raw'])
    if k in seen: continue
    seen.add(k); uniq.append(x)
payload={'source':'Danbooru wiki: sex + tag_group:sex_acts + tag_group:sexual_positions','generated':'2026-08-26','tags':uniq}
text=json.dumps(payload,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':'))
print('SAFE_TAG_COUNT='+str(len(uniq)))
print('MISSING_COUNT='+str(sum(1 for x in uniq if x['count']==0)))
print('SEXUAL_JSON_B64='+base64.b64encode(text.encode()).decode())
con.close()
'@; $pyPath=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'nai_make_sex_json.py'; Set-Content $pyPath $py -Encoding UTF8; & python $pyPath $tmp $namesPath; $code=$LASTEXITCODE; Remove-Item $tmp,$pyPath,$namesPath -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; exit $code
